# TheScoreBoard

> TheScoreBoard (thescoreboard.in) is a live tournament platform for grassroots sports communities in India. Players can find local tournaments by sport and city, register to compete, and follow live scores. Organisers can create tournaments, auto-generate brackets and fixtures, manage live scoring, and publish results instantly.

Supported sports: Football, Cricket, Table Tennis, and Badminton.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://thescoreboard.in/): Platform overview, featured tournaments, and how it works
- [Find Tournaments](https://thescoreboard.in/tournaments): Browse and filter all tournaments by sport, city, and status
- [Football](https://thescoreboard.in/football): Football tournaments and live scores
- [Cricket](https://thescoreboard.in/cricket): Cricket tournaments and live scores
- [Table Tennis](https://thescoreboard.in/table-tennis): Table tennis tournaments and live scores
- [Badminton](https://thescoreboard.in/badminton): Badminton tournaments and live scores
- [About Us](https://thescoreboard.in/about): About the platform and team

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://thescoreboard.in/privacy): How user data is handled
- [Terms of Service](https://thescoreboard.in/terms): Terms of use

## Notes

- Tournament pages live at /t/{slug} and show live brackets, fixtures, standings, and results.
- Registration for a tournament happens at /t/{slug}/register.
- Organiser and player dashboards require an account.
